description: Index of pre-converted ONNX Runtime (.ort) voice models hosted by fono-voice. Models are published as GitHub release assets tagged by ONNX Runtime ABI version; this file is the canonical machine-readable catalog. Two engines are indexed: Piper VITS voices (one .ort model + .onnx.json config sidecar each) and Kokoro voices (English; all share one kokoro-v1.0-q8f16.ort model and carry a per-voice 510x256 f32 .style.bin voice pack, byte-identical to the upstream onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX voice tensors). Kokoro entries add a 'gender' field. Per-voice license is taken from the upstream MODEL_CARD (Piper) or the upstream model card (Kokoro is Apache-2.0); check it before commercial use (some Piper voices are non-commercial). A third section, 'speaker_models', indexes ReDimNet2 speaker-verification embedding graphs (redimnet2-b3 default, redimnet2-b6 max tier; PalabraAI, MIT, opset 17, 192-dim embedding) each with a 'frontend' fbank spec and a pending AS-Norm 'cohort' sidecar; these are self-exported from the upstream .pt and require the unioned onnxruntime/ops.config minimal-runtime rebuild.

speaker_models.name: redimnet2-b3
speaker_models.note: Hosted on the ort-1.24.2 release; the minimal runtime was rebuilt from the unioned onnxruntime/ops.config and republished, and the .ort size/sha256 match the published bytes (reproducible from the pinned .pt via torch.onnx.export (opset 17, dynamo=False) + scripts/gen-ort-models.sh on onnxruntime 1.24.2). The AS-Norm cohort sidecar is not yet generated (Slice 4/5).

cohort.name: redimnet2-b3.cohort.bin
cohort.note: AS-Norm impostor cohort embeddings; generated in Slice 4/5, not yet produced.

source.onnx_export: self-exported via torch.onnx.export (opset 17, dynamo=False); waveform input [N,T], dynamic time axis
